v1.description: What happens when the document daemon has finished with one of a submission's uploads: what it produced is read onto the file - the Markdown, the PDF rendition, the chunk tree and what the parse learned about the document - or the failure is recorded on it, and once no parse is still going, the reading of the answers is queued. The start event names this module's own service user and nobody else: the event carries paths on the shared volume, and reading files from there into the repository is not something a person should be able to ask for.

ingest.label: Read the parse onto the file

queue.label: Queue the reading of the answers
